title: Heartbeats report reachable peers; the map colours each mesh line from both ends
goal: A mesh line shows whether the two peers reach each other, from their own reports
acceptance: A heartbeat carries the sender's reachable peers (bounded list of enrolled base ids), validated on receipt
`/api/bases` exposes them; the map colours a mesh line `--ok` when both peers report each other, `--warn` when one does not, neutral when unreported
A join test across two KajiLinks and the dashboard harness
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-18 from the owner request. Not a measurement.
